result.reviewScopeSummary: Verified Story 0 foundation scope against the story, full Context Workbench tech design, and test plan: record vocabulary, Feature 2 error/result helpers, fixture builders, temp workbench store helper, touched Epic 1 record/error surfaces, and verification script wiring, plus the Chunk 0 non-TC tests.

newFindings.title: green-verify does not detect staged test changes, so the configured story gate is untrusted
newFindings.evidence: `git diff --cached --name-only -- 'tests/**/*.test.ts' 'tests/**/*.integration.test.ts'` reported `tests/context-workbench/foundation.test.ts`, but `node scripts/guard-no-test-changes.mjs` still exited 0 and `npm run green-verify` passed. The guard implementation only checks unstaged tracked changes via `git diff --name-only --exit-code` and untracked files (`scripts/guard-no-test-changes.mjs:22-46`); it never inspects staged changes, even though that guard is part of the configured story gate in `package.json:15-19`.

additionalObservations: Story 0 has no epic-owned ACs or TCs; coverage came from the story scope/Definition of Done plus Chunk 0 NTC-1 and NTC-2.

The implemented record shapes match the cited design schema, including `ThreadViewRecord`/`BandRecord`/`ThreadViewMessageRecord`/`SearchResultSummary`/`WorkbenchChunkRead` in `src/context-workbench/domain/thread-view-records.ts:3-103` and the supporting Epic 1 linkage fields in `src/context-steward/domain/records.ts:48-159`.

The fixture and temp-store helpers satisfy the intended foundation seams in code and focused tests (`src/context-workbench/test/fixtures.ts:27-168`, `src/context-workbench/test/temp-workbench-store.ts:6-33`, `tests/context-workbench/foundation.test.ts:23-218`).

Production-path audit did not find a material fake adapter, shim, placeholder branch, or non-real fallback in the reviewed runtime/domain files (`src/context-workbench/domain/*`, `src/context-steward/domain/errors.ts`, and `src/context-steward/domain/records.ts`).
